title: reasons.json
description: One object per capabilities.csv row whose state is not checked-agrees: why the entry is not 'agrees'. build.py --check fails if such a row has no object here, if the object's state differs from the row's, or if a required field of its state is missing. Join keys: measure, tool.

reason.description: The reason in plain words, complete for its state: checked-convention names the convention, what each side does, the relation between the tool's value and the reference value and the tolerance; checked-defect says what is wrong, on which inputs, observed against expected, the tool version and the finding; checked-no-value says on which inputs there is no value and why, with the error text if known; reported-in-docs says why the entry was not run and the documentation source.

short.description: One sentence for tooltips and table cells.

reason_incomplete.description: True when the sources do not say everything the state requires; 'missing' then says what is not known.

missing.description: Present when reason_incomplete is true: what the sources do not say.

tool_version.description: Version of the tool that was run (checked states).

convention.description: checked-convention: the conventions involved (normalization, direction, weights, self-loops, multi-edges, ties, defaults, scaling, ordering, ...).

relation.description: The relation between the tool's value and the reference value where the sources state it.

mapping.description: checked-convention: the mapping of the reference value that reproduces the tool's value, with the tolerance after mapping.

tags.description: Structural conditions of the inputs (loops, multi_edges, directed, disconnected, ...; the list is in data.md).

named.description: Fixture names from data/fixtures.json (or sized fixtures) on which it was observed.

tags.description: Structural conditions of the inputs (loops, multi_edges, directed, disconnected, ...; the list is in data.md).

named.description: Fixture names from data/fixtures.json (or sized fixtures) on which it was observed.

observed.description: checked-defect: the value the tool gave.

expected.description: checked-defect: the value under the published definition.

variants.description: The measure's variants that differ or give no value, one object each.

why_not_run.description: reported-in-docs: not-yet-wired (the tool was run on other measures, no comparison is set up for this one), documented-only-tool (the tool is documented-only in this survey), commercial-closed-source (proprietary, cannot be run on the test machines).

documentation.description: reported-in-docs: the documentation or API listing the entry is taken from.
